namespace CM

partial def gcd (a : Int) (b : Int) : Int := Id.run do
  let mut a : Int := a
  let mut b : Int := b
  let mut cm_t1 : Int := 0
  let mut cm_t2 : Int := 0
  while (b != (0 : Int)) do
    cm_t1 := b
    cm_t2 := (Int.fmod a b)
    a := cm_t1
    b := cm_t2
  return (Int.ofNat (Int.natAbs a))

end CM
